faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Briefly about the board, messages, and payments.
faq.a1: It’s an online board whose cells are charged to fulfill specific intentions. You leave a short message, choose how many days to display it, and we play the frog every day to energize your intention.
faq.a2: Click “Start the Journey”, register if necessary, choose a cell and the number of days. Then pay — and your message will appear on the board.
faq.q3: How many days is the message displayed?
faq.a3: For as many days as you choose when purchasing. The rate is 1 cell per 1 day = $1.
faq.q4: Can I change or delete my message after posting?
faq.a4: Before reserving the cell — yes. After reservation, the text becomes fixed. If you need to edit, create a new message.
faq.a5: Yes. Insults, hate speech, adult content, and third-party personal data are prohibited. We may hide messages that violate the rules. See Terms of Use for details.
faq.q6: Where can I see my message live?
faq.a6: We host live streams and announce the schedule in advance on social media.
faq.a7: Apple Pay, Google Pay, or credit card. Payments are processed officially.
faq.q8: Is my message visible to everyone?
faq.a8: Yes, it’s a public section of the board. Do not post personal or confidential information. See the Privacy Policy for more details.

cookies.title: Frog Energy Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This page explains what cookies we use, why we use them, and how you can manage your choices.

what.title: What cookies are
what.body: Cookies are small files stored in your browser. They help the site function, remember your preferences, and collect anonymized analytics.

types.title: Types of cookies we use
types.i1: Strictly necessary — core functionality (sign-in, sessions). Without them the site won’t work.
types.i2: Functional — remember your preferences (language, UI state).
types.i3: Analytics — help us understand usage (Google Analytics). We only see aggregated reports.
types.i4: Marketing/third-party — may be set by embedded platforms (e.g., players or widgets).

list.title: Examples we may use
list.body: Names can vary by site version and providers:
list.i1: Service: session, auth/session-token — authentication and account functionality.
list.i2: Preferences: Next-Locale, sidebar_state — language and UI state.
list.i5: Payment providers may set their own cookies on their domains during checkout.
list.note: The exact set depends on your actions, settings, and integrations in use.

consent.title: Consent
consent.i1: On your first visit we show a consent banner: “Accept / Decline / Customize”.
consent.i2: Strictly necessary cookies are always set because the site depends on them.
consent.i3: Analytics and marketing cookies are enabled only with your consent.
consent.note: You can change your choice anytime in your browser settings or by reopening the banner (if available).

manage.title: Managing cookies
manage.body: You can delete cookies and block them in your browser settings. Note: blocking strictly necessary cookies may break the site.

thirdparty.title: Third-party cookies & providers
thirdparty.body: We use Google Analytics for stats. Cookies may also be set by payment providers during checkout and by embedded platforms (e.g., TikTok, YouTube).

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Cookie lifetime depends on type and your browser. Session cookies expire when you close the browser; persistent cookies typically last from 1 day up to 24 months.

cookies.updates: We may update this Policy. The current version is always available on the website.

cookieConsent.title: We use cookies
cookieConsent.text: Essential cookies keep the site working. With your consent we also use analytics (Google) and marketing cookies (Meta Pixel, Google Ads).
